bulk_virtual_ko.label: bulkKnk：训练网络与逐个体 KO/空扰动配对
interpretation_limits: API/source pinned to c49b106a4383e44ee19d08a75d7edcc99a865ea7; README and DESCRIPTION disagree on version; actual package version must be supplied
Per-individual null propagation and KO is an explicit adaptation; upstream cohort mean-shift and RF/survival extrapolation are not used
GENIE3 importance and heuristic DPI are not identified causal/signed regulation or ARACNE mutual-information DPI
Control targets are prespecified; their expression/outdegree are reported, not assumed matched

singlecell_virtual_ko.label: scTenifoldKnk：每个供者和细胞类型单独建网扰动
interpretation_limits: Native p.adj is conditional gene-space/model inference; donor population replication is not established
FC is a native regulation metric, not RNA log2FC; multi-gene KO requires a compatible package API

genki.label: GenKI：VGAE 基因潜变量扰动
interpretation_limits: Native latent-distance and cell-bootstrap bagging frequency are not RNA change, gene p-values or FDR; native pmt is with-replacement sampling with internal seed=0
Complete gene denominator retained; native significant-only selection is not substituted for all tested genes
Per-donor CPU models and same-context inference; no held-out-donor generalization claimed

celloracle.label: CellOracle：已拟合细胞类型 GRN 的条件扰动
interpretation_limits: Fitted GRN source, training and evaluation-unit overlap are checked
Clipping can prevent exact zero target expression; realized target means are returned
Model-conditional change does not establish a measured KO, actual trajectory or causal fate

gears.label: GEARS：真实扰动训练模型的单基因/组合预测
interpretation_limits: Requires real CRISPR perturbation-trained checkpoint with saved graph tensors and complete existing GO/cache assets
Single-perturbation-only training is not accepted as validated combination response
Predictions use donor-matched control cells; source currently consumes one prediction batch, capped at 300
Native uncertainty is not an interval; CRISPRi and complete KO remain distinct

geneformer.label: Geneformer：删除基因 rank token 后的嵌入变化
interpretation_limits: Explicit model/token version and local assets; all targets must occur in each tested token sequence
Delete is an input-token manipulation; no RNA fold change, KO direction or fate probability is produced
Gene list is perturbed jointly; not every combinatorial subset is silently enumerated

dynamo.label: Dynamo：已拟合向量场的 KO 动力学变化
interpretation_limits: Actual worker uses pd.KO, not a steady-state expression predictor
Needs an accepted fitted vector field and existing RNA dynamics/embedding evidence
Sensitivity requires separately reviewed, hash-bound fitted vector-field assets; changing an unused seed is not advertised as method robustness

metabolic_gene_deletion.label: COBRApy：基因/GPR 删除及代谢通量预测
interpretation_limits: Exact SBML GPR, mass balance, medium, objective, solver and WT feasibility must be reviewed
MOMA/ROOM objective_value is not growth: worker reads the specified biological objective reaction flux
Joint KO and individual deletions retained; synthetic lethality needs a prespecified criterion and measured follow-up
One metabolic model is not independent biological replication

cpa.label: CPA：扰动训练检查点的配对条件预测
interpretation_limits: Actual perturbation-fitted checkpoint with training provenance/ledger required; matched predicted-control subtraction removes reconstruction bias from the perturbation contrast
Dose/perturbation identity cannot change in a robustness rerun; no empirical accuracy without independent measured truth
Current API/architecture is fixed; prior pretrained-only models and unknown gene/category mappings are refused

scgpt.label: SCGPT：扰动训练检查点的配对条件预测
interpretation_limits: Actual perturbation-fitted checkpoint with training provenance/ledger required; matched predicted-control subtraction removes reconstruction bias from the perturbation contrast
Dose/perturbation identity cannot change in a robustness rerun; no empirical accuracy without independent measured truth
Current API/architecture is fixed; prior pretrained-only models and unknown gene/category mappings are refused

boolnet.label: BoolNet：逻辑节点固定和状态/吸引子分析
interpretation_limits: Native BooleanNetwork only, strict non-executable Boolean grammar and complete weighted binary initial states
Synchronous unresolved cycles fail; asynchronous endpoint activity is finite-horizon and not claimed stationary or an attractor proof
Initial states and simulation replicates are not independent biological units

maboss.label: MaBoSS：带速率随机逻辑网络 WT/KO 对照
interpretation_limits: Reviewed BND/CFG/rates, complete independent-Bernoulli initial probabilities, exact existing binary and package code
KO initial probability forced off as well as native OFF mutation; full unfiltered state mass and horizon checked
Native MC error is numerical simulation precision; last time point is not automatically stationary or a biological fate observation
